response.sql: WITH circuit_averages AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS circuit_average_round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(r.round) AS country_average_round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_average_round, ca.circuit_average_round - co.country_average_round AS difference FROM circuit_averages AS ca JOIN country_averages AS co ON ca.country IS co.country ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;
